definitions.explanation: The amount of water vapor present in the air, typically expressed as a percentage.

examples.japanese: {湿度|しつど}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{不快|ふかい}→不快：11386_fukai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{感|かん}じる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧。

⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{湿度|しつど}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧50%⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧60%⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{保|たも}つ→保つ：10134_tamotsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{理想的|りそうてき}→理想的：04797_risouteki⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われている→言う：00515_iu⟧。⟦{乾燥|かんそう}→乾燥：00184_kansou⟧⟦し→する：00392_suru⟧⟦すぎる→すぎる：01219_sugiru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{風邪|かぜ}→風邪：02188_kaze⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦ひき→ひく：01978_hiku⟧⟦やすく→〜やすい：18367_yasui⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: It's said that keeping room humidity between 50% and 60% is ideal. If it gets too dry, you become more susceptible to colds.

notes:
{湿度|しつど} refers to humidity as a measurable quantity, typically expressed as a percentage.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {湿度|しつど}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧ (humidity is high)
- {湿度|しつど}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{低|ひく}い→低い：02947_hikui⟧ (humidity is low)
- {湿度|しつど}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{調整|ちょうせい}→調整：14839_chousei⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to adjust humidity)
- {湿度|しつど}○○% (humidity at X%)
